name: Muffin
summary: Domed muffin with blueberries or chocolate chips in a ridged paper case, for bakery, breakfast and dessert scenes.

params.name: y
params.note: bottom centre: the muffin rests on y

params.name: s
params.note: scale; at s = 1 the item is hero size (~340 px wide); use about 0.2–0.3 next to a person

params.name: anim
params.note: bob = gentle up and down, wobble = small rock, pop = scale in with overshoot
